interface.title: EEG Speech Decoder: Real-time Neural Speech Decoder (Streamlit)
interface.field: Neuroscience / brain-computer interfaces (decoding imagined speech from EEG)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and demonstration: running a pretrained classifier on single EEG trials and inspecting the signals behind each prediction
interface.what_it_is_for: Load one EEG trial, either a synthetic phoneme trial or the first 1-second epoch of an uploaded EDF recording, view its channel waveforms and scalp topomap, and get a pretrained CNN-LSTM's predicted phoneme (/a e i o u p t k/) with per-class probabilities, alongside the true label for synthetic trials.

data.note: The synthetic trials come from the app's own generator. Each one is a single sample whose label is y = i % 8 with i = 0, so its true phoneme is always /a/ (eegspeech/models/dataset.py:56). All 8 synthetic trials in this run showed True phoneme 'a' (screens/006, 009, 010, 011, 041, 043). Comparing prediction with truth can therefore only show agreement or low confidence, never a different label. I also uploaded test_generator_2.edf (2.7 MB) through the Real EEG path. Only the first 1-second epoch of an uploaded EDF is classified (app.py:94, X[0]), and there is no control to pick another. Processing the file twice gave the same result (predicted /o/, 79.1%). The band-pass (1–50 Hz), resampling and epoch length are fixed, with no controls. No ground truth is shown for EDF data.

tree.specific: Classify a 1-second EEG epoch into /a e i o u p t k/ with the pretrained CNN-LSTM, and inspect its waveforms and topomap

features.name: Multichannel time-series viewer with channel picker and time-window slider
features.general: Choose a subset of sensors and a time window, then inspect the overlaid traces with zoom, hover readout, trace hiding and image export
features.specific: Pick EEG channels (with names like Fz, T3) in a searchable multiselect and set a Time Range (ms) range slider, and the Plotly 'Neural Signals' chart redraws. You can box-zoom, hover for (time, value) readouts, toggle legend traces, and download a PNG. Caveats: the time axis restarts at 0 for any window, the legend shows 'Channel N' rather than electrode names, the µV unit appears only on EDF data, and the channel and time selections change only this chart, not the prediction or the topomap.
steps: Open 'Select Channels to Visualize' and add channels, by clicking, typing a name, or 'Select all'; remove with × or 'Clear all'
Drag the two Time Range handles, or use Home/End on a focused handle
Box-zoom on the chart and hover a trace for its value
Click legend entries to hide traces
Double-click to reset, and use the camera button to save a PNG
serves_tasks: Limit the plot to a time window

features.name: Data-source switch: simulate a labelled trial or upload and preprocess a recording
features.general: Get one analysis-ready trial either from a built-in simulator with a label or from an uploaded file that is filtered, resampled and cut into fixed-length segments
features.specific: The Data Source radio switches between 'Synthetic' (Generate New Sample, which shows 'True phoneme', always /a/ here, and 'Sample age') and 'Real EEG' (Upload EDF File, 200 MB limit, then Process EEG). EDF preprocessing (1–50 Hz band-pass, resampling, 1-second epochs) is fixed, and only the first epoch is classified (app.py:94), with no epoch selector. Removing the uploaded file with × leaves the processed trial on screen. The loaded trial feeds every panel.
steps: Choose Synthetic or Real EEG in Data Source
Synthetic: press Generate New Sample (new random trial plus its true label)
Real EEG: upload a .edf file, then press Process EEG (first 1-second epoch is used)
Watch the waveform, topomap and prediction panels update together
serves_tasks: Bring in a real recording and preprocess it

features.name: Classifier result card with class-probability bar chart and ground-truth comparison
features.general: Show the top predicted class and its confidence, the full probability spread over all classes, and the known label when there is one
features.specific: The 'Predicted Phoneme' metric shows a confidence badge. Below it, a Plotly 'Class Probabilities' bar chart covers /a e i o u p t k/, and the sidebar shows 'True phoneme' for synthetic trials. You can hover bars for exact values and box-zoom to read the small classes. The ground-truth comparison is degenerate here: synthetic trials are always labelled /a/, and EDF trials have no label.
steps: Load or generate a trial so the model runs
Read the predicted class and its % confidence
Hover bars for exact probabilities and box-zoom to compare runner-up classes, then reset axes
Compare with the sidebar's True phoneme (synthetic only)
serves_tasks: Read the predicted category and how sure the model is
Compare the prediction with the known answer

features.name: Scalp topographic map of mean channel activity
features.general: Turn per-sensor averages into a head-shaped heat map with sensor positions and contours, and enlarge it for inspection
features.specific: The MNE topomap ('Brain Activation Map', 'Topographic EEG Activity') shows the mean absolute amplitude of each channel over the whole epoch. It redraws whenever a new synthetic trial or EDF epoch is loaded, and has a fullscreen button. It does not change with the channel or time-range selections.
steps: Read the head map; electrodes are shown as dots
Hover and press fullscreen to enlarge, then exit
serves_tasks: See how activity is spread over the head

A synthetic trial with a true phoneme other than /a/: the generator makes a single sample labelled y = i % 8 = 0 (dataset.py:56), so every synthetic trial is /a/ and a different true label cannot appear
Any EDF epoch after the first: the app classifies only X[0] (app.py:94), there is no epoch selector, and re-processing (screens/034.webp) gives the same /o/ 79.1% result
not_done: Training-history and confusion-matrix review is unavailable in this deployment: the images are not shipped and the app has no way to train. Only the 'not available' messages were seen.
Ground-truth comparison across different phonemes is impossible here: synthetic trials are always labelled /a/ (dataset.py:56), and there is no control to choose a phoneme.

The band-pass, resample and epoch settings for EDF processing are fixed and hidden (no controls), so other preprocessing options could not be tried. The UI does not show whether the filtering was applied.
Pressing Process EEG a second time (screens/034.webp) gave the same result and was dropped from the workflow.
I did not open the Streamlit main menu (settings/theme) or the Deploy button, which are framework chrome, not part of the tool.
I could not view the downloaded plot-image.png (binary): the tool reports only its size.
